hook: Your New Year arrives first in Kiribati.
title: Kiribati's islands see New Year first on Earth
description:
Kiribati's Line Islands run on UTC+14, the earliest time zone on Earth. That means the New Year reaches them before anywhere else. India is about eight and a half hours behind.

Series: Places That Shouldn't Exist.
comment_prompt: Would you spend New Year there? Yes or no
